items.markdown:
If you’re looking for a **blue Staffordshire Bull Terrier (“Staffy”) puppy in or around Essex**, I’d prioritise breeders where you can see the puppy **with its mother, visit the home environment, and verify health-test paperwork** rather than choosing based on colour or price.

### Places to start

- [Bullyview](https://www.bullyview.com/) — Wickford, Essex. This is a local Staffy breeder you could investigate, but I’d still independently verify licensing, health tests and the litter before putting down a deposit.
- Staffy puppies available for adoption Uk — Chelmsford. The listing describes it as a dog breeder, although I would verify exactly what litters are currently available and the breeder's credentials.
- **The Royal Kennel Club's Find a Puppy** is a useful place to search specifically for Staffordshire Bull Terriers and filter for puppies whose parents have health testing. [royalkennelclub.com](https://www.royalkennelclub.com/search/find-a-puppy/?ActiveCertifiedBreeder=False&Breeds=Staffordshire+Bull+Terrier&Distance=15&FemaleDogs=False&GeneralRescueClubs=False&HealthTested=False&MaleDogs=False&SearchRescueClubs=False&SortNearest=False&TotalResults=0&utm_source=chatgpt.com)
- There have also been recent Essex listings for blue Staffies on puppy marketplaces, but availability changes quickly, so I'd treat marketplace adverts as leads rather than endorsements. [Staffie-Owners.co.uk](https://www.staffie-owners.co.uk/staffies-for-sale/essex?colour=blue&kc_registered=yes&sex=male&utm_source=chatgpt.com) [Champdogs](https://www.champdogs.co.uk/litter/77166?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

### What I'd ask the breeder

Before paying anything, ask:

1. **“Can I see the puppy with its mum, at the place where it was raised?”**
 Don't accept a car-park handover or an excuse that the mother isn't available.
2. **“Can I see the original health-test results for both parents?”**
 For Staffies, particularly ask about **L-2-HGA and hereditary cataracts (HC)** DNA testing, plus the relevant eye examination. Breed-club guidance specifically recommends these checks. [Staffordshire Bull Terrier Club](https://www.northerncountiesstaffordshirebullterrierclub.co.uk/Code-Of-Ethics.php?utm_source=chatgpt.com) [SBTCA](https://sbtca.com/health/before-you-buy-a-puppy/?utm_source=chatgpt.com)
3. **“What are the parents' hip/elbow and eye results?”**
 Ask for the actual certificates/results rather than simply accepting “fully health tested.” [American Kennel Club](https://www.akc.org/breeder-programs/breed-health-testing-requirements/terrier-group-health-testing-requirements/?utm_source=chatgpt.com)
4. **“Why did you choose these two dogs to breed?”**
 A responsible breeder should be able to explain temperament, health, pedigree and what they were trying to improve.
5. **“How old is the mother, and how many litters has she had?”**
 Ask about previous pregnancies and any complications.
6. **“What socialisation have the puppies had?”**
 Ask whether they've experienced normal household noises, handling, people, children, other dogs, grooming, car journeys, etc.
7. **“What vaccinations, worming and microchipping will be done before I collect?”**
8. **“Will the puppy be KC registered, and can I see the registration/pedigree paperwork?”**
9. **“What happens if I can't keep the dog later?”**
 A good breeder should care about the puppy throughout its life and have a willingness to help with rehoming. [Staffordshire Bull Terrier Club](https://www.northerncountiesstaffordshirebullterrierclub.co.uk/Code-Of-Ethics.php?utm_source=chatgpt.com)
10. **“Can I take the contract home and read it before paying a deposit?”**

### One important point about “blue”

I'd **not pay a premium simply because a puppy is blue**. Colour is only one characteristic; health, temperament, structure and responsible breeding matter much more. The current Royal Kennel Club search does show blue Staffies being advertised, but it also lets you filter for health-tested parents. [Royal Kennel Club](https://www.royalkennelclub.com/search/find-a-puppy/?ActiveCertifiedBreeder=False&Breeds=Staffordshire+Bull+Terrier&Distance=15&FemaleDogs=False&GeneralRescueClubs=False&HealthTested=False&MaleDogs=False&SearchRescueClubs=False&SortNearest=False&TotalResults=0&utm_source=chatgpt.com) 

**Red flags:** the breeder won't let you see mum, wants to meet somewhere away from the home, has lots of different breeds/litters available, can't produce health certificates, pressures you to pay immediately, or focuses heavily on “rare/exotic” colour and size.

If you tell me **roughly where in Essex you're willing to travel from (e.g. Chelmsford, Colchester, Basildon, Harlow)** and whether you want **male or female**, I can search current listings and narrow it down to breeders/litters worth contacting.
